LIST.HINT: For an audience that doesn't know you. The list is cleaned before creating anything: missing or malformed email, duplicates, role addresses (info@, sales@…), previously unsubscribed or bounced, and domains that don't receive mail. If the email already belongs to a contact, that one is used. New ones are quarantined: they don't show in Contacts until they reply or click; those who never reply are deleted automatically.
LIST.ONLY_EMAIL: Lists are email only: on WhatsApp, writing to people who don't know you gets you blocked and Meta can downgrade or suspend your number.
LIST.NO_EMAIL_INBOX: You have no email inboxes. Create one in Settings › Inboxes (ideally with a separate domain for cold lists).

LIST.CLEANUP: Delete those who never reply after (days)

SIM.INTRO: See the whole campaign as a contact would get it: each touch with its text and when it goes out, and what happens depending on the reply. Nothing is sent.

OUTCOMES.appointment: Interested: the seller books the appointment with {to}.
OUTCOMES.relay_agent: Interested: goes to the agent «{to}» in the same conversation.
OUTCOMES.discarded: Not interested: leaves the campaign and gets no more touches; the reason shows in «Why they leave».
OUTCOMES.handoff: Asks for a person or gets upset: goes to {to} and the seller stops.
OUTCOMES.done: Finishes (confirmed, not coming or answered the survey): marked as done.
OUTCOMES.no_reply: Never replies: after {n} touches it ends as «No reply».
OUTCOMES.later: «Not now» or out of office: it writes once more on the date they say (30 days if not).
OUTCOMES.info: Interested: your full information is sent once, with images.
OUTCOMES.not_now: «Not this time»: we ask about next time (yes → {yes}; no → {no}).
OUTCOMES.opt_out: «Don't send me anything»: leaves the campaign.
